mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Creeping, crawling, going on the belly as a reptile.
E.
उरस् and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-हः)
Pain of the chest, pleurisy.
E.
उरस and ग्रह what seizes.

m. (-तः)
1 Striking or beating the breast.
2 Pain in the chest.
E.
उरस and घात a wound.

m. (-जः)
The female breast.
E.
उरस् the breast, and ज produced.
